ns2:course.label: Pre-Field Experience in Health
ns2:course.description: This is an independent study course that expands student's knowledge of health professions and prepares them for field work in an applied setting with a variety of health professionals. 1 undergraduate hour. 1 graduate hour.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing. Restricted to BS: Interdisc Health Sci -UIUC.
